layout_rules.font_fallback: system CJK fonts for Japanese, Korean and Chinese; preserve brand font when supported
layout_rules.rtl: future locales require mirrored reading order and native RTL captures, not flipped app screenshots

workflow: Translate benefits and search intent for the target market; do not translate keyword lists literally.
Approve 30-character name/subtitle and 100-character App Store keyword fields for each native app.
Capture the actual native app in that language and device family using demo fixtures.
Map copy and capture paths into a locale-specific campaign file.
Render art, rerender captions/video and inspect all exports at full resolution.
Set approval only after copy, app UI, timing, safety margins and CTA checks.
unimplemented: Automated translation and publishing. Locale placeholders are not translated exports.
